content: We’re announcing the preview of the Azure Cosmos DB hosted MCP experience, enabling enterprise AI agents to securely connect to business data through a standard, managed MCP endpoint. Agents can discover schemas, retrieve documents, and use full-text, vector, and hybrid search to ground responses in relevant, up-to-date data stored in Azure Cosmos DB. Because the experience is hosted and managed by Microsoft, you don’t need to deploy, patch, scale, or monitor your own MCP server infrastructure. You can focus on building intelligent, grounded agent experiences while using Azure identity, role-based access controls, and the performance and global scale of Azure Cosmos DB. Learn more.
